title: RAG Enhancement Suite — Query Pipeline Improvements
description:
Epic grouping all RAG enhancement issues for the Knox query pipeline, inspired by CORTEX-AI-SUPER-RAG techniques. Each feature is an optional, configurable plug-in step in the retrieval pipeline.

## Scope

- Semantic Cache for instant repeat-query responses
- Multi-Query Expansion (RAG-Fusion) for better recall on ambiguous queries
- CRAG (relevance grading) for cleaner synthesis context
- Neural Re-ranker (cross-encoder) for higher-quality ranking
- HyDE for sparse query handling
- Contextual Retrieval for better chunk embeddings

## Non-goals

- Knox remains primarily an LLM wiki / compiled content system. RAG enhancements are helpers, not the core.
- No full GraphRAG / entity graph exploration — Knox already has typed entity relations.
- No streaming think-panel or Streamlit UI — Knox has its own web UI.

## Completion criteria

- All 6 features implemented as optional plug-in steps
- Configurable via knox.toml
- Documentation updated

title: Semantic Cache for Query Layer
description:
Implement a cosine-similarity-based semantic cache for knox query: store query embeddings and answers; on repeat queries with similar meaning (threshold ~0.92), return cached answer directly instead of running retrieval + synthesis.

Location: knox.search (new module or added to retriever)
Configurable: enable/disable, similarity threshold, max cache size
Ties into: knox query --raw and knox query --synthesize

title: Update RAG/Query Technical Documentation
description:
After implementing the RAG enhancement features, update the technical documentation to cover:

1. docs/concepts/rag-pipeline.md — New page describing the complete query pipeline architecture (Semantic Cache → Query Expansion → Hybrid Retrieval → Neural Re-ranking → CRAG → Synthesis)
2. docs/guides/query-memory.md — Update with new query options and config parameters
3. docs/guides/configuration.md — Document new [search] config section (cache, reranker, crag, hyde, expansion)
4. docs/architecture/index.md — Update architecture diagram to show enhanced RAG flow
5. mkdocs.yml — Add new pages to navigation

Each technique section should include: what it does, when to enable/disable, performance trade-offs, config reference.

title: Contextual Retrieval for Chunk Enrichment
description:
During T2 chunking, have the LLM prepend a brief situating context paragraph to each chunk before embedding. Each vector then carries the full document narrative, not just a fragment. Benefits both compilation and query.

Location: knox.chunking — optional enrichment step during HierarchicalChunker
Config: enable/disable, model override
Note: adds tokens per chunk, may slow indexing

title: Neural Re-ranker (Cross-Encoder)
description:
Add a cross-encoder re-ranking step (e.g. ms-marco-MiniLM via sentence-transformers) after hybrid fusion. Re-ranks top-K candidates by true query-passage relevance, improving ranking quality over pure embedding similarity.

Location: knox.search.retriever — optional re-ranking phase
Config: model name, top-K to re-rank, enable/disable
Dependency: sentence-transformers (already in deps)

title: CRAG — Corrective RAG
description:
Add a relevance grading step after retrieval: the LLM scores each retrieved chunk on relevance to the query. Chunks below threshold are dropped before synthesis. Improves answer quality by filtering noise.

Location: knox.search.retriever — post-retrieval, pre-synthesis
Config: enable/disable, threshold
Ties into: knox query --synthesize

title: Multi-Query Expansion (RAG-Fusion)
description:
Generate N query variants via LLM from the user's original query, retrieve independently for each variant, then merge all ranked lists via Reciprocal Rank Fusion for better recall. Addresses ambiguous or under-specified queries.

Location: knox.search.retriever — new step before hybrid retrieval
Config: number of variants (default 3-5), optional
Ties into: existing RRF fusion in HybridRetriever

title: HyDE — Hypothetical Document Embeddings
description:
For sparse or ambiguous queries, generate a hypothetical ideal answer passage first via LLM, then use its embedding for retrieval instead of the raw query. Improves retrieval for short queries.

Location: knox.search.retriever — optional pre-retrieval step
Config: enable/disable, model override
